ideas.title: Collect all pending payments and require payment before delivery
ideas.detail: Ten sales are still pending. Send reminders every Friday. For new orders take Zelle or online payment first; cash only on pickup.

ideas.title: Add every product to Inventory and use the dropdown when logging sales
ideas.detail: Swim shirts, Old stock and Independence tees are sold but not in Inventory, so their stock and profit are invisible. Add them and always pick names from the list.

ideas.title: Set a fixed price list with planned promo prices
ideas.detail: Hoodies have sold anywhere from $38 to $66. Decide a full price, a friends price and a bundle price, and stick to them.

ideas.title: Clear slow sizes with bundles and adjust the size mix on the next order
ideas.detail: Bundle a hoodie with a tee, or run a promo on sizes that are not moving. Use the Inventory sold % column to decide.

ideas.title: Reorder best-selling sizes 4 weeks before they sell out
ideas.detail: Suppliers take 3–4 weeks. When a top size drops to 3 units, place the order or open pre-orders.

ideas.title: Take pre-orders to fund each drop
ideas.detail: Collect payment up front for the next drop so stock is paid for before it arrives, and you only order sizes people want.

ideas.title: Get a POS / card reader that logs sales automatically
ideas.detail: From the notes: after registration, set up a POS. Shopify POS would put in-person and online sales in one place.

ideas.title: Get quotes from a second supplier
ideas.detail: Harlen is good but has quality issues sometimes. Compare cost, quality and lead time from at least two others before the next drop.

ideas.title: Consolidate Shopify and IONOS website costs
ideas.detail: You pay both every month. Check whether the domain can move to Shopify, and whether an annual plan is cheaper.

ideas.title: Track sales per campaign and test organic content before paid ads
ideas.detail: The Instagram ads reached about 2,600 people but brought 9 followers and no tracked sales. Try customer photos and try-on videos first, and note which post each sale came from.

ideas.title: Early-access list for repeat customers
ideas.detail: Your repeat buyers are your best marketing. Give them first pick on the next drop.

ideas.title: Save phone or Instagram for every customer at checkout
ideas.detail: Only one customer has contact details saved. Add them in Customers so you can announce drops directly.

ideas.title: Monthly physical stock count to correct inventory
ideas.detail: Count what is actually on the shelf at month end and fix the Original stock numbers if they are off.
